description: Sector overlay for U.S. manufacturing, product safety, workplace safety, quality, labeling, environmental, and regulated-product documentation.

metadata.scope: United States sector overlay controls for Manufacturing. Intended to be used with us/core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis revalidated against authoritative U.S. federal statutes, regulations, agency and regulator materials, and applicable model/professional or industry standards available through 2026-08-30. This rule pack remains an evidence-screening control set, not legal advice, and requires qualified legal/compliance review before production reliance. State, territorial, tribal, and local requirements may impose additional obligations.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: OSHA laws and regulations / 2024 Hazard Communication Standard update
CPSC consumer product certification and mandatory eFiling requirements
used_for: mandatory eFiling effective July 8, 2026 for most regulated imports

primary_sources.name: EPA manufacturing sector and environmental compliance materials
FTC Made in USA Rule and truth-in-advertising materials
FDA CGMP requirements where manufacturing involves regulated food, drug, device, or cosmetic products

rules.title: OSHA workplace safety and hazard-control evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for OSHA workplace-safety controls, including hazard communication under the 2024 HCS update and applicable 2026 extended compliance dates, PPE, machine guarding, lockout/tagout, and incident/safety-program evidence.

metadata.evidence_expectation: The reviewed document/document set should contain direct textual evidence for this control, or the engine should return missing/review_required according to the rule strategy.
metadata.review_guidance: A qualified U.S. legal/compliance reviewer must confirm applicability, legal sufficiency, federal/state interaction, and whether absence of textual evidence should be treated as non-compliance.
source_basis: OSHA 2024 Hazard Communication Standard final rule and 2026 compliance-date extension

rules.title: Product safety certification or conformity evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for CPSC product-safety certification/testing, GCC/CPC, recall readiness, updated certificate content, and—beginning July 8, 2026 for most regulated imported consumer products—mandatory electronic filing of certificate data with CBP.
